verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents first-party function/tool calling in a dedicated guide and in the Responses API reference. Its agents guide describes models using tools and maintaining context across steps, and the tools guide covers calling your own functions and composing tool calls programmatically, so the core agent-loop capability is clearly present. However, the pack never explicitly evidences parallel tool calls or typed/schema-defined tool parameters; JSON Schema adherence is shown only for Structured Outputs, not for tool definitions. missing for 10: explicit parallel tool-call documentation, typed tool-definition schema evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call faithfulness

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model

citations.quote: Function calling (also known as tool calling) provides a powerful and flexible way for OpenAI models to interface with external systems and access data outside their training data.
Agents can plan and complete tasks using tools, work with other agents, and maintain context across steps.
call your own functions, compose tool calls in JavaScript, or access third‑party services
Have the model call your own custom code or use built-in tools like web search or file search to use your own data as input for the model's response.
